assumptions: 8 deterministic seeds per strategy and progress stage; 14 days, two logins 12 hours apart, up to 40 casts each
all strategies use 0.17 fishing probabilities, story spacing, same region abilities, voyage claims and optional habitat/appearance/festival policy
first-island stages build the first island only; late stages begin with all six islands, max gear/buildings/pets; no equipped companions
leave declines stories; repair/explore prepare with coins when at least 200; rescue prepares with food when at least 10; otherwise safely leave
story rewards never scale by cast bet; no repeat-memory rewards; failures use the displayed fallback
no chapter/collection/captain/coop claims, paid currency or ads; fixed policies are not real player preference or retention evidence
